case.background: A pure sample of one radionuclide is sealed in identical holders and observed with a shielded counter. Vary elapsed time and sample mass, then infer how measured activity changes.
initial_observations: The count rate decreases after isolation even though the holder remains sealed.
A separately measured background remains present at late times.

controls.description: Mass of the pure radionuclide in the holder.
controls.name: sample_mass_mg

instruments.description: Sealed sample holders, a shielded counter, timer, and background calibration.
instruments.name: shielded_radiation_counter

notes: All samples contain the same pure radionuclide with the same initial specific activity.
Each holder remains sealed; detector geometry, collection efficiency, and background are fixed.
Self-absorption and detector dead time are negligible over the public control range.
The Oracle reports a deterministic mean rate, not individual random counts.

FinalSubmission.model must equal 'expression'. FinalSubmission.parameters must equal {'outputs': {READOUT: EXPR, ...}} with exactly these readouts: count_rate_cpm. EXPR is the shared family-neutral JSON arithmetic tree over public controls. Supported operators are: add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, negate, exp, log, sin, maximum, step. No candidate law family or truth-specific parameter slots are supplied.

readouts.description: Mean detected count rate including background.
readouts.name: count_rate_cpm
